second_order: bringing people in to make and protect our flag
theme_note: These passages all recruit participation in the same flag effort: asking for help, explaining why more pixel placers matter, and calling people to join and protect it. What varies is whether recruitment is framed as making the flag turn out better or defending the motherland.
This passage moves discussion of the Canada and provincial or territorial flags toward a named subreddit; it belongs with no other code and remains a single-code theme.
